annotation.title_clean: Regulação da inteligência artificial: experiências internacionais e desafios para o Brasil
annotation.title_en: Regulation of artificial intelligence: international experiences and challenges for Brazil
annotation.venue: Câmara dos Deputados - Estudos das Consultorias Legislativa e de Orçamento e Fiscalização Financeira
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Repository record for a Brazilian Chamber of Deputies legislative consultancy study on AI regulation. It surveys international approaches (UNESCO, US, China, Japan, Russia, EU, UK) and discusses challenges in designing a balanced regulatory model for safe AI development in Brazil. Only the abstract is available.
key_provisions_or_claims: Surveys recent AI regulation in UNESCO, US, China, Japan, Russia, EU and UK
Discusses difficulties of a balanced regulatory model for Brazil
Aims to enable safe AI development in Brazil
Subjects include civil liability and personal data protection
